items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He learned from the best, those guys in my band, like Wynton Kelly and Bill Evans.

ctx.x: He learned from the best, those guys in my band, like Wynton Kelly and Bill Evans. They really (inaudible) some records with me. They showed him how to do it. And he got all the credit for that.

Yeah, right. What's your sense of Miles, as a person and as a musician? I'm thinking, for example, the impression he gives and has given for years of being in command, that nobody is going to con him, no business people are going to hustle him. He's not going to be one of those musicians that gets ripped off.
